item.tib: bcud dril bkra shis gter rdzongs gyi rgyud las bum pa'i le'u
item.coloph: stag lha me 'bar thugs kyi sgrub pa bkra shis gter rdzong gi rgyud las/ sngon 'gro bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi le'u nyung bkod gsal sgron zhes pa 'di/ snyigs ma'i kho bo pad+ma rjes gnas bya khri 'bar ba'i g.yas zur du bkod pa smar ro//
